record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set learning rate=0.001 and dropout=0.20, retaining maxlen=128, width=128 and one GRU layer. Larger updates may learn sparse item representations faster, while moderately stronger dropout limits overfitting from those updates. Unlike the previously regressed shorter-history/lower-rate configuration, retain the existing history coverage. Preserve loss, embedding design, readout, batch size, seed 42, 200 batches per epoch and the 200-epoch cap.

category_rationales.rationale: Across all four datasets, jointly increase learning rate to 0.001 and dropout to 0.20. Larger updates may accelerate learning of sparse item representations, while stronger dropout may limit overfitting. Retain history length 128, hidden width 128, one GRU layer, existing loss and readout, and training caps. Existing predictor loading remains compatible.
